title: Site editor shows the resolved slot words and lets owners edit a bound line inline

source.ref: Follow-up to LIVE-1356 (shared Space content slots)

detail: A kit's {{slot|sample}} token no longer shows as raw text in the editor. The inspector fields show the resolved words; the canvas matches, highlights and inline-edits the resolved line. Saving keeps the token on every field the owner did not change (keepSlotTokens), and a field the owner changed takes their words in place of the token.

verify.evidence: Vitest: inspector shows resolved words and keeps the other token on edit; canvas inline-edits a bound line and saves the typed words; keepSlotTokens unit tests.
